welcome.title: Welcome to brae
welcome.description: Let's set up your experience in about 1 minute.

language.title: Choose Your Language
language.description: Select your preferred language. You can change this anytime.

en.name: English
en.greeting: Hello! How can I help you today?

region.title: Where do you write from?
region.description: Helps brae read regional idioms the way you mean them. UI stays in your chosen language.

es-CO.label: Spanish (Colombia)
es-CO.description: "cuenta" often means "tell me", "regalame" is polite "please pass me".

es-AR.label: Spanish (Argentina)
es-AR.description: Voseo ("vos sabes"), "che", "laburo" for work, "quilombo" for mess.

es-ES.label: Spanish (Spain)
es-ES.description: Vosotros, "vale", "tio", "curro" for work, "flipar" for being amazed.

en-GB.label: English (UK)
en-GB.description: "cheers" as thanks, "quite" softens, "fancy" as want, "brilliant" as great.

en-US.label: English (US)
en-US.description: "awesome" as great, direct phrasing, "fix" prefers a solution over "sort out".

en-AU.label: English (Australia)
en-AU.description: "no worries", "arvo" for afternoon, diminutives like "servo", informal register.

model.title: AI Model Preference
model.description: This model runs every task brae performs for you. The default is Gemma 4 31B, served by Google via OpenRouter — a balanced choice for cost and capability. You can change it later from Settings.
model.appliesToAll: This model handles every task. Customize per-task models below if you want finer control.

personality.title: Choose Your AI Style
personality.description: Select how brae should behave. You can customize this later.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Clear, warm, and privacy-first. The recommended default.

creative.name: Creative
creative.description: Explorative, bold, and full of ideas. Great for brainstorming.

precise.name: Precise
precise.description: Rigorous, structured, and methodical. Perfect for technical work.

ready.title: You're All Set!
ready.description: Your preferences have been saved. Let's start chatting.
ready.error: We could not save your preferences. Please try again.
